test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 15 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The 'India Lounge', set up by the IBEF was inspired by the 'Make in India' programme. What does IBEF stand for?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India Brand Equity Foundation**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **India Brand Equity Foundation (IBEF)** is an initiative by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India.
 
• IBEF aims to promote and create international awareness of the "Made in India" label in markets overseas and to facilitate the dissemination of knowledge of Indian products and services.</l
